provider_type.description: Form 2441 line 1 column (c), as the instructions have the filer write it: an organization's EIN, "Tax-Exempt" for a tax-exempt organization, or an individual's SSN. Required. The provider's name, address and number themselves are identifiers and never cross — synthetic placeholders stand where the engine wants them, the way the W-2 employer's EIN does.

is_household_employee.description: Form 2441 line 1 column (d): “Was the care provider your household employee in 2025? For example, this generally includes nannies but not daycare centers.” Required. A yes is the dictionary's own knockout (Schedule H is not carried here), served with words.

amount_paid_cents.description: Form 2441 line 1 column (e), the amount paid to this provider in 2025. Required. Carried onto line 1; the credit itself reads the per-person amounts on line 2 (persons[].care_expenses_cents), so this column changes no dollar at the pin.
